objective: Replace the failed short-horizon/linear alpha learners with one causal nonlinear walk-forward model explicitly trained to identify 60-session relative compounders, while retaining the current best ownership/execution engine.

failed_learning_boundary.adaptive_expectation: The prior 12-candidate Ridge family targeted 5/10/20-session return minus downside penalty and produced negative prequential skill plus low wealth. No horizon/penalty/shrinkage neighbor is reused.
failed_learning_boundary.relative_rank: The prior mature-cohort linear 3-feature relative-rank model improved joint-removal pair accuracy but worsened wealth by 16.65%. This family therefore does not optimize pair accuracy or fit the old ranking coefficients.
failed_learning_boundary.matured_displacement_memory: The non-contextual action-memory family also failed, proving that average historical replacement payoff is not a sufficient alpha state.

label.economic_basis: 60 is the existing long trend lifecycle used by the offensive ownership stack; it is not selected from a horizon grid.
label.target: raw stock log return minus the cross-sectional median valid raw return for the same origin and horizon.
label.maturity: An origin can enter training only when its end open is at or before the current signal session.

training.cohorts: Only origins with session_index % Config.rebalance == 0 are training cohorts; Config.rebalance is 10 in the frozen runtime. This prevents dense overlapping daily labels and introduces no new cadence parameter.
training.schedule: Refit at signal sessions with session_index % Config.rebalance == 0 using every valid matured historical cohort available then. Between refits the last fitted model is reused.
training.model: sklearn.ensemble.HistGradientBoostingRegressor(random_state=34) with all other sklearn 1.8.0 defaults exactly; no hyperparameter search.
training.fallback: Before any valid matured training rows exist, use the unchanged current causal score.

treatment.score: When a fitted model exists, its predicted 60-session relative log return replaces only the alpha score matrix used by the current campaign-peak ownership engine. Non-ready symbols remain score=-inf.
treatment.entry_and_lifecycle: Observed-trend entry/exit predicates, acute failure, funded campaign references, fresh-challenger provenance, campaign-peak displacement authority, capacity, actual-cash funding and execution semantics remain unchanged.
treatment.time_comparability: The prediction is always in the same economic unit: expected 60-session relative log return, so funded admission alpha and later decay comparisons remain economically coherent.

causality.strict: Features at D use D close and earlier only. Training at D may use labels only whose end open is <= D. Prediction for D executes no earlier than D+1.
causality.prefix_test: For every session in a tested prefix, the full-snapshot and prefix-only learned score matrices, resulting targets and orders must be identical.
causality.determinism: Frozen sklearn==1.8.0, random_state=34, deterministic cohort schedule and symbol ordering.

structural_difference.old_expectation: Nonlinear pooled 60-session cross-sectional excess target rather than Ridge short-horizon absolute return/downside utility.
structural_difference.old_relative_rank: Predicts an economically calibrated long-horizon excess-return value used as a time-comparable ownership score, not a 3-feature linear pair/rank score.
structural_difference.old_trend_quality_absolute_leadership: Those were fixed hand formulas. This model learns nonlinear interactions only from fully matured causal history.

measurement.primary: mean(log(terminal wealth)) across the three fixed scopes
measurement.promotion: Treatment must strictly exceed campaign-peak mean-log and must not reduce campaign-peak minimum terminal wealth.
measurement.if_promoted: Evaluate identical source-bound treatment over all 896 frozen sessions before formal-matrix expansion.

prohibitions: no changing HistGradientBoosting defaults after seeing results
no post-result edit of this preregistered family
